{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "doc/REST-interface.md edit is a one-line follow-up to the REST error response change",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes in this PR are incidental updates describing the altered REST error responses."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to support pruning",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Allows running -txindex concurrently with block pruning, resolving multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). Pruned nodes gain the ability to maintain transaction lookups without storing full historical block data on disk."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies JSONRPCError to support an optional error.data object across src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, and src/rest.cpp",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends RPC and REST error handling by returning candidate block hashes when target transactions are located in pruned blocks. This allows callers of getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof to distinguish pruned transactions from missing ones and retrieve blocks on demand."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "test_runner.py edit only registers the new feature_txindex_prune functional test",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications are domain-specific tests validating txindex functionality rather than test infrastructure changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely to adjust startup argument compatibility checks between -txindex and -prune",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Init adjustments merely follow the index and configuration change rather than altering utility primitives."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
